# Closing the window's last pane while a program runs asks once, not
# again for the window it takes along; Edit ▸ Undo brings the window back,
# its program still running. A window that closed for good while it waited
# for Undo (its programs all ended, which closes it) stays closed.
# (tests/run.sh gives it undo-timeout = 30s: the shell's exit is waited for.)
type:sleep 31338
key:enter
wait:0.8
action:close_surface
wait:0.6
expect-sheet:yes
expect-sheet-text:A program is still running
sheet:Close
wait:0.8
expect-sheet:no
expect-windows:0
undo:go
wait:0.6
expect-windows:1
expect-shell:pgrep -f 'sleep 3133[8]' >/dev/null && echo STILL-RUNNING ==> STILL-RUNNING
key:ctrl+c
wait:0.4
type:sleep 3; exit
key:enter
wait:0.3
action:close_window
wait:0.3
sheet:Close
wait:0.5
expect-windows:0
# Its shell exits while it's hidden: closed for good, and Undo can't show it.
wait:4.0
undo:go
wait:0.6
expect-windows:0
